SEC Charges BG Wealth and DSJ Exchange in Alleged $130 Million Crypto Fraud
items.summary: The agency says investors lost more than $100 million after the firms promised risk-free trading returns and used false filings to claim SEC approval.

items.title: India's ED Announces Searches in $524 Million Crypto Transfer Probe
items.summary: The agency named Binance and Bybit as platforms used for alleged foreign payouts, without announcing charges against either exchange.

items.title: Justin Sun's HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With Financial Watchdog
items.summary: The FCA says the Justin Sun-linked exchange will no longer target UK consumers, ending its first case against a crypto firm over marketing.

items.title: Treasury Sanctions 11 Over North Korean IT Worker Scheme That Moved Millions in Crypto
items.summary: Two Russian nationals converted more than $5 million in crypto for North Korean networks, according to OFAC, which listed their wallets.

items.title: Bitcoin Treasury Datavault AI Says It Can’t Access Its BTC, Stock Tanks
items.summary: Datavault AI says it has been unable to withdraw its Bitcoin from Biconomy since June and will restate four financial reports tied to a $150 million Scilex deal.

items.title: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
FCA stops HTX's crypto promotions
items.summary: The FCA has secured High Court undertakings to ensure that HTX (formerly Huobi), a global crypto exchange, will not knowingly promote cryptoasset services unlawfully to UK consumers.
